annotations.exact_quote: this article presents a global and local topology-aware contrastive graph clustering network (GLAC-GCN) for attributed graph clustering
annotations.reason_zh: 提出带GCN管线和聚类分布输出的图聚类网络，属于利用可学习神经表示获得数据划分的深度聚类。

annotations.exact_quote: the local topology structure, and global semantic information are simultaneously utilized to refine the graph
annotations.reason_zh: 显式利用局部拓扑与全局语义信息修正图结构，符合学习或修正样本间边/拓扑结构的定义。

annotations.exact_quote: two pipelines of GCNs are jointly and interactively utilized
annotations.reason_zh: 方法以GCN管线作为主要学习组件，通过图卷积获取表示，满足图神经网络定义。

annotations.exact_quote: the contrastive learning is enforced by minimizing the mismatch of the cluster distributions obtained from different GCN pipelines
annotations.reason_zh: 通过最小化不同GCN管线聚类分布间的不一致来实施对比学习，属于视图/管线间的区分性表示学习目标。

annotations.exact_quote: both the original graph and the globally and locally refined graph are treated as input graphs
annotations.reason_zh: 同一图数据的原始图与全局/局部修正图作为多个拓扑输入，并被两条管线联合交互学习，符合多视图/多观测联合利用设定。
